title: Interrupted interval installation
proposition: A single omission in a repeated structure becomes visible through viewer movement.
intended_experience: Notice order first and discover one interruption after moving.
excludes: Explanatory text that identifies the omission

differentiation.statement: The omission is discovered through parallax rather than sound.

feasibility.technical: A paper scale model can test the spatial relation.

uncertainties.statement: The interruption may not be visible from all required viewpoints.
